description: Update settings on a single Elementor element (merge by default). With widget_type, replaces the widget in place (same id, position and parent), e.g. turn a V4 placeholder into a V3 html widget; the type must be registered with Elementor.

settings.description: Settings to merge into (or, with settings_mode replace, to become) the element's settings

settings_mode.description: merge (default) or replace: settings become the element's complete settings

widget_type.description: Replace the widget type in place (cvrt-mcp-endpoints 1.13.0+). Widgets only, not containers.

name: mcp_update_elementor_element
